final_text: In `app/session.py`, `PRECOMPACT_MIN_CONTEXT_PCT` is now 30, so Claude sessions get `min_context_pct` and `arm_threshold` of 30 from `_precompact_policy`. I added a separate class constant, `CODEX_PRECOMPACT_MIN_CONTEXT_PCT = 5`, and the Codex policy now reads that instead. I replaced the old comment above the Claude constant with one giving the 30% measurement rationale. I didn't run any tests.
